title.narrative: Support to the First China International Import Expo

description.narrative: China will host the first China International Import Expo from November 5 to 10, 2018 in Shanghai in cooperation with international organizations including WTO, UNCTAD and UNIDO. The expo represents the important measure that China has taken to further open up its market to the world, and it will increase imports from other developing countries. The Ministry of Commerce of China requested the Secretariat of UNIDO to provide support to the first China International Import Expo in November 2017 during the 17th Session of UNIDO General Conference. The main purpose of the project is to assist relevant departments of China to organize the first China International Import Expo, promote international cooperation and facilitate the import from all countries and regions around the world to China under the framework of ISID and SDG, and increase the awareness and participation of the public and private sectors. Through organizing side events and exhibitions during the CIIE, this project will contribute to increasing export from developing countries and promote their SMEs development.
